text: Onions and garlic are versatile ingredients for a wide range of dishes, each enhancing the flavor of various meals. Garlic pairs particularly well with pasta, adding a rich, savory taste to sauces and broths. Onions, on the other hand, contribute a deep, mellow flavor to soups, braises, and stews, helping to thicken and enrich the broth. Both ingredients, when chosen from the freshest, firm bulbs, add depth and authenticity to culinary creations, making them essential for any kitchen.
